name: codebuddy-docker
description: CodeBuddy ACP in Docker; replace the image and host login directory before registration
before_start: Confirm the Docker image and host mount paths with the user and check that they are available on the execution host.
after_start: Complete any required harness authentication and wait until the session is ready before sending work.
special_instructions: Login mounts persist the harness credentials, not bridge credentials. Do not put secrets in template env.
